## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain what was wrong and what this change makes possible.

## Research and implementation scope

Identify the active protocol, affected command/analysis layer and evidence kind. Link any design amendment or source/task reference needed to review the change.

- [ ] Real execution, diagnostics, synthetic fixtures and planned outcomes remain distinct.
- [ ] Changes to task inclusion, information boundaries, framework/model identity, budgets, metrics or denominators are documented.
- [ ] No credentials, private manuscript/mock data, authenticated traces or unapproved third-party content are included.

## Validation

List the actual commands and results, including skipped/not-run checks. Documentation changes should pass `node scripts/check-docs.mjs` and `./scripts/check-public-boundary.sh`. Shared runtime or analysis changes should include the relevant tests and portable offline verification.

## Remaining limits

State anything that still needs official artifacts, a live fixture, a particular platform, human review or provider access. Do not equate synthetic tests with benchmark success.
